description: One sample per error code (contract/ERROR-CODES.md). Codes are stable; messages are illustrative and may change. All data fictional.

forbidden.message: officer-4821 has no active identity mapping

conflict.message: status transition closed -> open is not allowed

duplicate_note: duplicate is returned as HTTP 200 inside a success wrapper — see case-create.json replayResponse

internal.message: unexpected failure; safe to retry with the same externalRequestId

not_activated_note: while the CID lane is dormant every operation returns 501 {"error":"not_activated"} — outside the stable vocabulary on purpose
